tracked_apps.description:
**Currently detected application**

> ### {preview_name}
>
> `{raw_value}`

**Note**

Snapshot only — not live. Use Add to enroll this application even after the child switches apps or exits.

To detect a different app, close and reopen: **X → Configure → Tracked applications**.

Application List edits are saved only when you press **Save changes**; nothing is written to Windows.

windows_updates.title: Trusted Windows update channel
windows_updates.description: ADMIN ONLY. A fixed HTTPS catalog provides the approved version; a separate fixed HTTPS release directory provides signed Windows archives. Pin the Ed25519 PUBLIC key directly from your supervised local provisioning (never from MQTT). MQTT Install remains disabled until explicitly enabled AND the Windows PC advertises signed v2 capability. The Windows updater must also have a trusted Authenticode signer, protected task and rollback. Never paste private signing keys, passwords or child details here. Updating this form does not deploy, install or activate any Windows agent.

data.ota_install_enabled: Enable signed MQTT Install (after trusted PC bootstrap)

profile_copy.title: Profile copy
profile_copy.description: Copy the complete configuration from another Gaming Control device. Submit replaces the current profile. Device identity, gaming history and existing bonus grants are preserved. Windows update installation authorization is never copied.

error.no_live_candidate: No fresh uniquely identified application detected. Start it on the selected PC and reopen Configure.

error.invalid_application: Invalid application row, duplicate process, or invalid name. Only the verified foreground process can be added.
error.no_tracked_apps: No HA-managed applications to modify yet.
error.invalid_signed_release: Use a fixed HTTPS catalog and release directory, a valid Ed25519 PUBLIC PEM key, and all required fields when enabling updates. No settings were changed.
error.invalid_profile_source: The selected source is no longer available. Choose another Gaming Control device.
error.invalid_profile_configuration: The source profile contains invalid settings. No settings were changed.

abort.no_profile_sources: No other Gaming Control device is configured yet.
